summary_md: **小周同学 ([@hello_xiaozhou](https://x.com/hello_xiaozhou/status/2116470988535669129))** curates ten repos to push agents beyond landing pages into design, 3D, motion and video: Impeccable, UI UX Pro Max, Blender MCP, img2threejs, video-shotcraft, HyperFrames, Penpot, Remotion, lemo-opuscar and diagram-design ([ahujasid/blender-mcp](https://github.com/ahujasid/blender-mcp), [img2threejs](https://github.com/img2threejs/img2threejs), [remotion-dev/remotion](https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion)).
